g.text: Cycle 01 | TREC Deep Learning 2019–2020 | Exploratory development evidence
A Training-selected k vs fixed k=60
B k effect under depth truncation
2019: the same 43 queries across n=4–7. 2020: 54 queries (n=4). n = number of rankers.
Selected k: training folds only; query-level held-out scores averaged over five seeds of five-fold CV.
Whiskers (B): conditional 95% query-bootstrap intervals; predictions fixed, not confirmatory.
Reused development data. Truncation changes evidence/candidates; attenuation does not isolate a causal mechanism.
